title: `ERC6909.transferFrom` Allowance Race Condition + Missing Zero-Address Checks Enable Stale-Allowance Double-Spend
impact: `approve` overwrites allowances without the ERC-20 `increaseAllowance`/`decreaseAllowance` pattern, enabling the classic **approve front-running race**: a spender can observe a pending `approve(spender, newAmount)` in the mempool and spend the *old* allowance before the new one lands, then spend the new allowance — net effect is spending up to `old + new`. Additionally, `transfer`/`transferFrom`/`_mint`/`_burn` perform **no `receiver != address(0)` check**, so tokens sent to `address(0)` are silently burned from circulation while `balanceOf[address(0)]` accrues — a permanent, unrecoverable loss of the `id`'s supply accounting.
